scope: Bounded follow-up of two recent public EV transaction datasets for prospective numeric tariff plus measured energy and user/session context. No fitting, installation, old-review changes, large-library download or access requests.
conclusion: Two legitimate public real-transaction sources have measured session energy and identifiers. The Jiaxing source additionally publishes a numeric TOU schedule as a separate CSV. Neither examined source establishes a verified session-level prospective consumer price/offer. Jiaxing is a useful narrow future tariff-association lead after price applicability is resolved; neither is ready to replace the existing continuous-compensation experiment.

sources.title: A high-resolution electric vehicle charging transaction dataset with multidimensional features in China
sources.paper_reported_size: 441077 transactions, 13 stations, two-year period. Full counts not recomputed because the complete transaction CSV was not downloaded.
sources.license: The downloaded Figshare v3 metadata explicitly says CC BY 4.0 for the data/code deposit. The article license is a different CC BY-NC-ND license; do not conflate the article license with the dataset license.
sources.actual_acquisition: Downloaded 4854-byte versioned repository metadata and 11557-byte Code.zip. Read the public Dataset.zip central directory using only its final 65536 bytes; it lists Charging_Data.csv, Time-of-use_Price.csv and Weather_Data.csv. Extracted the entire 181-byte tariff CSV from that bounded tail and verified its CRC32 against the ZIP central directory. Requested only an additional 8192-byte archive prefix range and decompressed a bounded 4096-byte beginning sample of Charging_Data.csv. The 14.9MB archive and 85.6MB full CSV were not downloaded.
sources.measured_outcome: Transaction power/kwh is explicitly defined as session energy in kWh, despite the misleading use of power in its column label. User identifier and timestamp/station context are present in the inspected sample. Session start/end times are not physical effective-response duration truth.
sources.author_code_read_not_executed: Code/TOU_analysis.py reads external TOU.csv and joins the price by session Start Time, after restricting its figure to Nanhu and non-abnormal records. The deposited tariff member is named Time-of-use_Price.csv, so this is not an immediately identical filename contract. The code does not show a prospective per-session offer field or calculate actual consumer unit rate from billing. It aggregates each session's total kWh by its starting-time slot; that is not a measured 15-minute energy load curve.
sources.critical_price_match_check: The first inspected row is Nanhu at 2020-12-31 23:35:43, with 6.24kWh and 2.6 yuan electricity cost. Its billing is not enough to certify the separately published 0.3784 yuan/kWh schedule as the actual rate applied to that user/session. No tax/markup interpretation is invented. Billing-cost/energy ratios are not promoted to ex-ante treatment variables.
sources.official_tariff_reference: The paper cites a 2019 Jiaxing government page for its TOU table: https://www.jiaxing.gov.cn/art/2019/9/25/art_1685296_38320694.html . The referenced URL returned HTTP404 in the direct metadata review, so effective dates and station/user applicability were not independently verified here.
sources.target_limits: Only three rate levels and time-based assignment, not continuous randomized compensation. Price is tied to clock time, which is also chosen by users and related to charging demand. The session table lacks the eligible no-session population, prospective offer/notification, SOC and intended departure/energy need. It therefore supports observational tariff/time association only after applicability validation, not an identified causal dose-response or an accuracy benchmark.
sources.decision: Retain as the best of the two new observational leads. Do not integrate or fit now; require authoritative effective tariff/customer mapping or explicit offer evidence first.

sources.title: A dataset for multi-faceted analysis of electric vehicle charging transactions
sources.paper_reported_size: 72856 sessions, 2337 subscribed users and 2119 chargers, commercial operation 2021-09-30 to 2022-09-30. Repository description instead says 2238 users. This discrepancy is left unresolved rather than selecting whichever number looks convenient.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 verified from the versioned Figshare metadata; paper also describes this dataset license.
sources.actual_acquisition: 4028-byte repository metadata, 5914-byte author Code.zip and a 4096-byte HTTP206 prefix sample of ChargingRecords.csv. Full 7605859-byte CSV not downloaded and full counts not recomputed. Author R scripts read as text, not executed.
sources.schema_difference: The actual deposited CSV sample has 13 columns. The paper describes 16 including session ID, capacity and AC/DC fields; those are absent from the inspected header. Do not promise those fields are in this downloadable file.
sources.energy_and_user: Demand is defined by the paper as energy delivered in kWh; Duration is charger connection minutes. UserID=0 combines other-company/nonmember users and cannot be treated as one repeated physical user. The inspected initial rows are UserID0, so they do not establish identifiable subscriber behavior.
sources.price_issue: Paper Tables3-4 reproduce KEPCO low/high-voltage options and seasonal time slots. Actual CSV contains no rate, bill, tariff-option identifier, announcement time or service fee. ChargerCompany is only a binary own/other categorization and does not establish the exact consumer tariff option. Operator electricity acquisition tariff is not automatically the price charged to EV drivers.
sources.decision: Reject as a directly price-linked source under the present requirement. Keep only the source record and bounded sample; do not fetch or analyze the full dataset in this follow-up.

completion: Bounded follow-up stopped after these two sources. No confirmed individual ex-ante numeric EV price/offer was established. A real public numerical tariff schedule and measured session-energy samples were established, with their linkage limitations explicit. Original ev_sources.json and its downloaded originals were not changed.
